title: Your first test
brief:
The shop is open on the right. Finish this test so it checks that the browser tab's title is `Automation Exercise`.

One line is all it takes. The matcher you want is `to_have_title`, and it goes on the `page`, not on a locator:

```python
expect(page).to_have_title("...")
```
starter:
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect


def test_home_page_has_the_right_title(page: Page):
    # ARRANGE + ACT: open the shop's home page
    page.goto("https://automationexercise.com/")

    # ASSERT: check the tab title. Your line goes here.
solution:
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect


def test_home_page_has_the_right_title(page: Page):
    page.goto("https://automationexercise.com/")
    expect(page).to_have_title("Automation Exercise")
